chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Musa ibn Yasar al-Manqari from Ali ibn Ja'far al-Sakuni from Isma'il ibn Muslim al-Sha'iri from Abu Abdillah from his father from his forefathers, peace be upon them, that the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"Place the hands where you place the face, for they prostrate just as the face prostrates."

key_terms.يَسْجُدَانِ: they prostrate (dual form, referring to the two hands)

ai.seo_question: Where should the hands be placed during prostration in Islamic prayer according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the jurisprudential principle that the hands are an integral part of the prostration, requiring them to be placed in the same spatial position as the face to ensure uniformity in the act of submission. It reflects the Shia emphasis on precise physical adherence to the Prophet's practice (Sunnah) as transmitted through the Ahl al-Bayt, reinforcing the concept that every part of the body involved in sujdah must equally demonstrate humility before Allah.
